Soul Windows desktop island
nodes.rationale: Local, edge-attached tools without AI, accounts or network services.

nodes.label: Application shortcuts
nodes.rationale: Pin installed apps or add executable shortcuts.

nodes.label: Global indexed search
nodes.rationale: Background filename/path index across accessible mounted drives; cached queries, live filesystem notifications and keyboard launching.

nodes.label: Encrypted rich clipboard
nodes.rationale: Keep local bounded history of text, formatted content, images and file paths.

nodes.label: Windows media controls
nodes.rationale: Read active player metadata and artwork; seek only where supported.

nodes.label: Direct system controls
nodes.rationale: Toggle Wi-Fi and Bluetooth radios; native brightness with explicit software dimming fallback.

nodes.label: Confirmed power actions
nodes.rationale: Existing power commands remain confirmed; further power work deferred.

nodes.label: Deferred hardware checks
nodes.rationale: Physical monitor changes, other players, radio disconnection cycles and exclusive fullscreen dimming still require hardware checks.

nodes.rationale: Current black-and-gold controls; simulated music with local system readings.

nodes.rationale: Current music panel with example metadata, artwork and seeking.

nodes.rationale: Global search interface using isolated fixture files, with keyboard selection.
